note: Based on the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself recast from the original description of Roonwal & Verma 1972; the soldier and the pseudoworker are described and measured, while the alate is given in the original as Imago Unknown. Type specimens examined; type locality Chackai, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown, darker apically; mandibles dark brown at the base, nearly black apically; anteclypeus whitish; antenna whitish, brownish on the several apical segments; thorax and abdomen straw; legs dirty white. Head sparsely setose, thorax and abdomen more densely so. Body length about 8.5—10.0 mm. Head long, subrectangular; head length to the lateral base of the mandible 3.16—3.42, head width 2.10—2.39 mm; frons sloping anteriorly. Eyes small (maximum diameter 0.18, minimum diameter 0.14 mm), close to the antenna. Ocelli absent. Antenna densely setose, 14—15 segments, segment 2 longer than 3, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus with short setae, fairly broad; anteclypeus narrow, whitish. Labrum subsquare, with a few setae near the rounded anterior margin. Mandibles short and stout (length 1.84—1.89 mm), slightly more than half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.54—0.58); left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, right with 2 prominent marginal teeth. Postmentum long (length 2.10—2.53, maximum width 0.68—0.89 mm), very broad anteriorly, club-shaped; waist long and narrow (0.3—0.4 mm). Pronotum as wide as or slightly wider than the head (length 1.05—1.58, width 2.10—2.74 mm), densely setose; anterior margin weakly concave, with a weak median notch. Legs short and stout, femora slightly swollen; tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen densely setose; cerci and styli short, densely setose.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule straw; antenna and body paler. Head subcircular (length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.58, width 1.84—1.89 mm). Eyes and ocelli both absent. Labrum dome-shaped (length 0.39—0.42, width 0.47—0.58 mm), anterior margin rounded, with a few short setae. Antenna short, 15 segments, segment 3 shorter than 2, segment 4 shortest. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum subrectangular (length 0.95—1.05, width 1.81—2.10 mm), slightly wider than the head; anterior margin distinctly concave.
